# UseThisSI

> One top AI tool pick per job for builders, vibe coders, AI agent tinkerers and indie game devs. Pricing last checked 2026-10-14.

## Use cases
- [Vibe-code an app or landing page](https://usethissi.vercel.app/use-cases/vibe-code-an-app-or-landing-page/): top pick Lovable. Chat-to-full-stack app with hosting; easiest on-ramp.
- [AI coding assistant](https://usethissi.vercel.app/use-cases/ai-coding-assistant/): top pick Cursor. Leading AI IDE with cloud agents.
- [Set up or run AI agents](https://usethissi.vercel.app/use-cases/set-up-or-run-ai-agents/): top pick n8n. Open-source agent and workflow builder.
- [Automate workflows](https://usethissi.vercel.app/use-cases/automate-workflows/): top pick Make. Visual automation with the best affiliate terms.
- [Make game art and sprites](https://usethissi.vercel.app/use-cases/make-game-art-and-sprites/): top pick Scenario. Style-trained, consistent game assets.
- [Generate music and SFX](https://usethissi.vercel.app/use-cases/generate-music-and-sfx/): top pick Suno. Best song gen with commercial rights on Pro.
- [Edit and generate video](https://usethissi.vercel.app/use-cases/edit-and-generate-video/): top pick Runway. Pro-grade generative video.
- [Write content](https://usethissi.vercel.app/use-cases/write-content/): top pick Claude. Best long-form writing voice.
- [Research](https://usethissi.vercel.app/use-cases/research/): top pick Perplexity. Fast cited answers.
- [Voice and TTS](https://usethissi.vercel.app/use-cases/voice-and-tts/): top pick ElevenLabs. Most realistic voices plus 22% recurring affiliate.
